evidence: Modifies `.github/actions/configure-docker/action.yml`, `ci/test/02_run_container.py`, and `contrib/devtools/shell-win64-cross.nix` to configure the CI cross-compiler toolchain and logging.
rationale: Aligns CI Nix Windows builds with Guix release binaries by switching from MCF to POSIX threads. As noted in issue #36314 and commit 1d59d5ad25, the toolchain mismatch meant CI verified binaries with a different threading runtime than production releases.
